latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Easily add full-page tiled text watermarks to images using CamScanner.

- Supports overlaying custom, repeating diagonal text (e.g., "Confidential", "Draft") across the entire image.
- Customize watermark color, opacity, and font size.
- Simple 3-step workflow: image upload, apply watermark, and download.
- API instructions provided for bash/curl users.
- Privacy: Images are processed on CamScanner cloud servers, not permanently stored.
- Includes error handling tips and notes on file format compatibility.
